name: Home Chef Production Center Douglasville GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open driveway off Skyview Dr into front lot, then an open paved curve around the NE corner into the east dock apron. No barrier arm, sliding gate, or checkpoint pinch-point at the road or at the yard transition (verified in 2025-03 Street View and z20 satellite).
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at the entrance. The dark pad near the NE corner is a utility/transformer pad set in landscaping, not a windowed guard booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Continuous dock bank along the full ~600 ft east wall with ~25-30 reefer trailers backed in; total door count estimated ~40 (band 25-50) from z19 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: All trailers are backed into dock doors (active); no separately marked bobtail/drop-trailer stalls visible, so dropArea NONE.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Single east dock apron runs the building length and can hold a 3+ truck queue along the dock face.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial corridor off I-20 in Lithia Springs/Douglasville, woods and a retention pond bordering the site; judged Rural per rubric tie-break.
fieldNotes.location: Confirmed 2120 Skyview Dr (geocoded to Lithia Springs/Douglasville GA 30122; supplied coords were ~2.5 km west in a residential area and were wrong). Building front carries the painted '2120' address number, verified in Street View.
